en.text: Shout for joy to the LORD, all you lands!

zhSimplified.text: 普天下当向耶和华欢呼！

zhTraditional.text: 普天下當向耶和華歡呼！

en.text: Serve the LORD with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.

zhSimplified.text: 你们当乐意事奉耶和华， 当来向他歌唱！

zhTraditional.text: 你們當樂意事奉耶和華， 當來向他歌唱！

en.text: Know that the LORD, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

zhSimplified.text: 你们当晓得耶和华是 神！ 我们是他造的，也是属他的； 我们是他的民，也是他草场的羊。

zhTraditional.text: 你們當曉得耶和華是上帝！ 我們是他造的，也是屬他的； 我們是他的民，也是他草場的羊。

en.text: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.

zhSimplified.text: 当称谢进入他的门； 当赞美进入他的院。 当感谢他，称颂他的名！

zhTraditional.text: 當稱謝進入他的門； 當讚美進入他的院。 當感謝他，稱頌他的名！

en.text: For the LORD is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.

zhSimplified.text: 因为耶和华本为善。 他的慈爱存到永远； 他的信实直到万代。

zhTraditional.text: 因為耶和華本為善。 他的慈愛存到永遠； 他的信實直到萬代。
